title: Mara and the Alibi
author: Kestrel Sterling
blurb: Casper Sterling, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
